==Russian==

===Etymology 1===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*peyḱ-|id=mark}} {{dercat|ru|ine-bsl-pro|ine-pro|inh=1}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|писати||to write; to paint}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*pьsati}}. Related to {{m+|la|pingō}} (whence {{m+|en|paint}} and {{m|en|picture}}).

====Pronunciation====
* {{ru-IPA|писа́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-писать.ogg}}

====Verb====
{{ru-verb|писа́ть|impf|pf=написа́ть|vn=писа́ние<q:nomen actionis; nomen obiecti>,письмо́<q:nomen actionis; nomen obiecti>,писа́льщик<q:nomen agentis, occasional>,пи́сарь<q:nomen agentis>,писа́тель<q:nomen agentis>,писа́ка<q:nomen agentis>,писани́на<q:nomen resultatis>|vadj=пи́саный,пису́чий}}

# to [[write]]
#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1846|author=w:ru:Фёдор Достоевский<t:{{w|Fyodor Dostoevsky}}>|title=w:ru:[[Бедные люди]]|chapter=s:ru:[[Бедные люди (Достоевский)/Апрель1|Апреля 8.]]|location=|publisher=|newversion=English translation from|translator2=w:Constance Garnett|title2=s:en:[[The Gambler and Other Stories/Poor People|Poor People]]|location2=|publisher2=|year2=1914|page2=|pageurl2=|text=Вы говори́те, что у вас глаза́ слабе́ют, так не '''пиши́те''' при свеча́х; заче́м '''писа́ть'''?|t=You say your eyes are weak; so you must not '''write''' by candlelight; why '''write'''?}}
# {{lb|ru|literary}} to [[paint]] (a [[painting]])

===Etymology 2===
{{bor+|ru|de|pissen}}, from {{der|ru|fro|pissier}}, from {{der|ru|la-vul|*pissiāre}}, of {{onomatopoeic|ru|title=echoic}} origin.

==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|бѣжа́ть||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|title=бежа́ть|:inh|orv:бѣжати<ety:inh<sla-pro:*běžati>>}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|бѣжати}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*běžati}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-bsl-pro|*bēˀgjā́ˀtei}}, from {{inh|ru|ine-pro||*bʰégʷ-y-eh₂-ti}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*bʰegʷ-||to flee, run}}. 1-st person singular and 3-rd person plural, as well as imperative forms derive from {{m|ru|бечь}}, from {{der|ru|sla-pro|*běťi}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|бежа́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-бежать.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-бежать.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|бежа́ть|both|pf=побежа́ть}}

# {{lb|ru|imperfective|_|only}} to [[run]], to be [[running]]
# to [[flee]], to be [[fleeing]]
# to [[avoid]], to be [[avoiding]], to [[shun]], to be [[shunning]]
# to [[run after]] {{+obj|ru|:за(ins)<someone>}}

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|uni|impf=бежа́ть|pf=побежа́ть|other=бе́гать}}
* Some meanings of the verb are imperfective only (as indicated); others are both imperfective and perfective.

====Conjugation====
''imperfective''
{{ru-conj|impf-intr|irreg|бежа́ть}}
''perfective''
{{ru-conj|pf-intr|irreg|бежа́ть}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{af|ru|за-|-ня́ть}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|заня́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-занять.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|заня́ть|pf|impf=занима́ть}}

# to [[borrow]]
# {{lb|ru|nonstandard}} to [[lend]] (standard: [[одолжить#Russian|одолжи́ть]])
# to [[occupy]], to [[take up]]
#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1869|author=w:ru:Лев Толстой<t:{{w|Leo Tolstoy}}>|title=w:ru:[[Война и мир]]|chapter=s:ru:[[Война_и_мир_(Толстой)/Том_3|Том 3, Часть первая, IX]]|location=|publisher=|newversion=English translation from|translator2=w:en:Aylmer and Louise Maude|title2=s:[[War and Peace (Tolstoy)/Book 9/Chapter 9|War and Peace]]|location2=Oxford|publisher2=Oxford University Press|year2=1922–1923|page2=|pageurl2=|text=Интере́с це́нтра производя́щейся огро́мной войны́ '''за́нял''' кня́зя Андре́я, и он рад был на не́которое вре́мя освободи́ться от развлече́ния, кото́рое производи́ла в нём мысль о Кура́гине.|t=His mind was '''occupied''' by the interests of the center that was conducting a gigantic war, and he was glad to be free for a while from the distraction caused by the thought of Kurágin.}}
# to [[employ]], to [[busy]]
# to [[reserve]], to [[secure]], to [[keep]]
# to [[interest]], to [[engross]]

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{af|ru|за-|-нима́ть}}

# to [[borrow]]

#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1836|author=w:ru:Николай Гоголь<t:{{w|Nikolai Gogol}}>|title=w:ru:[[Нос (повесть Гоголя)|Нос]]|chapter=s:ru:[[Нос (Гоголь)/Глава II|Глава II]]|location=Санкт-Петербург|publisher=w:ru:[[Современник (журнал)|Современник]]|newversion=English translation from|translator2=w:Oliver Ready|title2=w:[[The Nose (Gogol short story)|The Nose]]|location2=London|publisher2=w:Pushkin Press|year2=2019|page2=|pageurl2=|text=Он кли́кнул Ива́на и посла́л его́ за до́ктором, кото́рый '''занима́л''' в то́м же са́мом до́ме лу́чшую кварти́ру в бельэта́же.|t=He summoned Ivan and sent him off for the doctor, who '''occupied''' the best apartment on the first floor of the same building.}}
